tools.name: create_public_preview
tools.description: Turn a complete standalone HTML document already created in this chat into a temporary, read-only 2ools preview. Free and authless; expires after 24 hours. This tool does not generate the page—write the HTML first, then call it.

tools.name: list_build_systems
tools.description: List the Curators, Rulebooks, and Skills this paid account may explicitly apply. Use before build_from_conversation when the user names a creative system or asks what is available.

tools.name: build_from_conversation
tools.description: Create a new 2ools project from a structured conversation brief and queue one durable build. Returns project_id and job_id; use get_build to retrieve completion status and the protected preview.

tools.name: refine_project
tools.description: Create one protected child version from a saved base version and concrete review feedback. Preserves the base source as currentCode, consumes one persisted project iteration, and returns an asynchronous job_id.

tools.name: get_build
tools.description: Get one build's current status, progress, errors, completed version IDs, and protected preview URLs. Does not return generated source code.

tools.name: compare_versions
tools.description: Compare two saved versions in one project without returning source. Reports lineage, review state, page additions/removals, byte sizes, and SHA-256 identity for each page.

tools.name: list_approval_requests
tools.description: List exact saved versions waiting for a separately delegated reviewer. Returns project/version identity and attribution, never generated source.

tools.name: approve_version
tools.description: Use separately delegated review authority to approve one saved version and make it the project's active version. Does not publish, export, or change project permissions.

tools.name: reject_version
tools.description: Use separately delegated review authority to reject one saved version. If it is active, restores its saved parent as active; the rejected version remains in immutable history.

tools.name: cancel_build
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running non-Agent 2ools build. Completed versions are not deleted and terminal builds are left unchanged. Governed Agent execution uses cancel_agent_rEngine and provider selected by the person. Fails before project creation or queueing when that Engine is offline, busy, missing the provider, or lacks the protocol. Never falls back to hosted, server, Studio, or another c

tools.name: get_build
tools.description: Get one build's current status, progress, errors, completed version IDs, and protected preview URLs. Does not return generated source code.

tools.name: get_engine_dispatch
tools.description: Read the authoritative state of one exact Engine dispatch. Queued means accepted but not started; running appears only after the selected Engine atomically claims the lease. Returns claim, heartbeat, failure, and terminal state without client inference.

tools.name: compare_versions
tools.description: Compare two saved versions in one project without returning source. Reports lineage, review state, page additions/removals, byte sizes, and SHA-256 identity for each page.

tools.name: list_approval_requests
tools.description: List exact saved versions waiting for a separately delegated reviewer. Returns project/version identity and attribution, never generated source.

tools.name: approve_version
tools.description: Use separately delegated review authority to approve one saved version and make it the project's active version. Does not publish, export, or change project permissions.

tools.name: reject_version
tools.description: Use separately delegated review authority to reject one saved version. If it is active, restores its saved parent as active; the rejected version remains in immutable history.

tools.name: cancel_build
tools.description: Cancel one exact queued or running non-Agent 2ools build after named explicit confirmation. Repeating the same cancellation is safe, late Engine results are rejected, completed versions are never deleted, and immutable history remains. Governed Agent execution uses cancel_agent_run.

tools.name: get_account_profile
tools.description: Read the authenticated person's 2ools profile, current account labels, and server-derived effective MCP scopes. Passwords, private credentials, billing instruments, and provider secrets are never returned.

tools.name: update_account_profile
tools.description: Update only the explicitly supplied profile fields for the authenticated person. This cannot change email, password, MFA, billing, entitlements, roles, or account-deletion state.

tools.name: get_project_access
tools.description: Read the authenticated person's role plus the canonical project owner, members, and pending invitations. Non-managers can read active members but never receive pending-invite metadata.

tools.name: invite_project_member
tools.description: Invite an existing 2ools username or an email address to one owned project as a collaborator or viewer. New-account claim tokens are emailed by 2ools and are never returned through MCP.

tools.name: update_project_member_role
tools.description: Change one exact member to collaborator or viewer, or transfer ownership. Requires explicit confirmation because demotion cancels that member's active builds and pauses armed project agents, while ownership transfer changes the current owner's authority.

tools.name: remove_project_member
tools.description: Remove one exact member's project access after explicit confirmation. Their account and authored history stay; active project builds are canceled and armed project agents are paused.

tools.name: revoke_project_invite
tools.description: Revoke one exact pending project invitation after explicit confirmation. The person can no longer accept that invitation; project history remains auditable.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Open the native Project OS entry point and list recent 2ools projects the authenticated account can access. The app automatically continues the only saved project or shows an inline chooser when several projects are available. Returns compact metadata without generated source.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get a 2ools project's brief, selected pages, active version, and compact version history. Does not return generated source code.

tools.name: get_project_context
tools.description: Read one source-free operating packet: active version metadata, the latest explicitly selected observed project input, review attention, artifact index, work queue, and current activity cursor. Imported input is immutable evidence, not an AI proposal or live filesystem sync; private 2ools skills, pr

tools.name: continue_project
tools.description: Return one project's current Living Plan, next useful move, continuity-readiness gaps, latest evidence, and a compact 2ools-active receipt. Opens a compact status, Continue, and Open Project OS card on MCP Apps hosts; the full Project OS belongs in the host's browser side panel.

tools.name: refresh_project_cockpit
tools.description: Refresh the bounded project state shown inside an already-open 2ools MCP App. This app-only read does not start work, import files, or change the project.

tools.name: activate_project
tools.description: Record the person's one-time choice to use this already-connected 2ools client with one exact saved project. Call only after the person approves in the inline card or explicitly in chat. This does not read or import local files and does not start work or a build.

tools.name: get_project_mission
tools.description: Return a bounded canonical Project Mission view, active Goal Contract, server-derived health, role capabilities, or a paginated goals, templates, scope-change, or history slice.

tools.name: get_project_intelligence
tools.description: Return the versioned frontier-product research dossier, six parallel lane states, evidence ledger, saturation audits, falsification, concepts, ranked outputs, integrity summary, connector visibility, and a deterministic operating brief. Missing premium access is reported as a gap, never invented.

tools.name: update_project_intelligence
tools.description: Initialize or append one immutable, validated dossier revision. The complete snapshot must cite material claims, preserve unknowns, finish or explicitly block all six lanes before synthesis, include a reproducible saturation audit, and pass falsification/output gates. Revision conflicts require a re

tools.name: get_project_discipline
tools.description: Return derived direction, trade-off, evidence, and continuity status with active decisions, eval evidence, verifier definitions, and explicit permission boundaries. Status is computed from authoritative Project OS records, never editable checkboxes.

tools.name: list_project_engineering_decisions
tools.description: List native-safe engineering decisions for one exact project, including the canonical project revision, category, risk, question, rationale, tradeoffs, response contract, constraints, and current state. Never returns secrets or internal prompts; unknown future response kinds remain in Project OS.

tools.name: answer_project_engineering_decision
tools.description: Accept or reject one exact native-safe engineering decision at one exact project revision. Requires an explicit confirmation and durable note, enforces project role and high-risk owner policy, rejects revision conflicts, preserves immutable history, and returns an idempotent receipt plus canonical r

tools.name: manage_project_discipline
tools.description: Propose a project trade-off, version an eval case or verifier definition, or attach an eval/verifier receipt to exact work. Agents may propose decisions but cannot accept their own proposals; verifier definitions describe external evidence and never execute arbitrary code on 2ools.

tools.name: update_project_mission
tools.description: Create or revise Mission and Goal contracts, explicitly transition or reorder goals, or propose a scope change. Server role, revision, conflict, and safety policy remain authoritative.

tools.name: review_project_mission
tools.description: Restore an immutable Mission or Goal revision, decide a proposed scope change, or submit proof-based goal completion review. Completion and high-risk authority remain server-gated.

tools.name: manage_work_watchdog
tools.description: Pause, park, resume, or reprioritize one durable task, or deliberately configure the project Watchdog. This never answers for the user, approves a risky action, deploys, spends, sends externally, deletes data, or widens authority.

tools.name: act_on_project_os_task
tools.description: App-only route for an authenticated person's explicit click in the native Project OS panel. Hidden from the model; every action is revision checked and idempotent, and cancellation requires an explicit confirmation.

tools.name: update_living_plan
tools.description: Add, edit, move, or reorder open Living Plan items from the current conversation, then return the refreshed inline plan and timeline panel. This cannot mark returned work complete; completion remains a separate evidence-backed review decision.

tools.name: render_project_preview
tools.description: Render an interactive, read-only card for one saved 2ools version. Use after get_build or get_project when the user wants to see, open, or share the result. Returns protected preview and access-checked workspace links without source code.

tools.name: list_project_agents
tools.description: List the authorizing account's built-in Agents assigned to one readable project. This reveals status and summary, not full Limits or run traces.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Read one Agent's saved Limits, trigger, immutable revision summaries, and redacted append-only run traces. Raw prompts, tool arguments, credentials, and source bytes are not returned.

tools.name: run_project_agent
tools.description: Queue real execution for a project-linked Agent the person already test-ran and armed. The immutable saved Limits, project access, account fuse, and online Engine requirement are enforced server-side before a job exists.

tools.name: get_project_agent_mode
tools.description: Read the project-level autonomous coordination state derived from the canonical Living Plan, governed Agent, and exact Engine destination. Returns progress, current work, next eligible safe step, and the reason the project is running or needs the person.

tools.name: configure_project_agent_mode
tools.description: Turn the selected project's governed Agent Mode on or off. When enabled, the person chooses one armed project Agent, one exact Engine, and one provider; only reviewed safe-auto steps in the exact approved plan may advance in dependency order. Limits and approval boundaries are never widened.

tools.name: advance_project_agent_mode
tools.description: Idempotently re-evaluate and, when safe, queue the next dependency-ready safe-auto plan step on the project's already approved Agent, Engine, and provider. Running, review, blocked, and approval states never double-dispatch.

tools.name: dispatch_project_work
tools.description: Reserve one exact revision-checked Project OS task for one armed project Agent, then queue it on one exact online Engine and authenticated provider selected by the person. Queued is not working; the task becomes active only after that Engine atomically claims it. Never falls back to another computer

tools.name: get_project_work_dispatch
tools.description: Read the authoritative queued, claimed, running, approval-paused, or terminal state of one exact governed Project OS task dispatch. Returns bounded progress and lease evidence without prompts, credentials, source, paths, or private model transcripts.

tools.name: cancel_agent_run
tools.description: Stop one queued or running Agent execution and close its durable run history. Completed, failed, stalled, and already-canceled runs keep their terminal truth.

tools.name: get_project_activity
tools.description: Read the attributable project timeline across human work, external MCP agents, builds, versions, feedback, and workspace pins. Actor kind is explicit; an external agent is never presented as the human account that authorized it.

tools.name: wait_for_project_activity
tools.description: Wait up to 20 seconds for attributable project events newer than a head_cursor or prior next_cursor. Returns events oldest-first so an outside agent can process them in order. If resync_required is true, paginate get_project_activity instead of advancing the cursor.

tools.name: list_project_feedback
tools.description: Read page-anchored review feedback for versions in a project, with explicit human or external-agent attribution.

tools.name: add_project_feedback
tools.description: Add an attributable review comment to a saved project version. This does not modify source or approve the version.

tools.name: resolve_project_feedback
tools.description: Owner-only review decision that resolves or reopens one saved feedback item.

tools.name: list_project_pins
tools.description: Read shared workspace notes and http(s) links, with explicit attribution.

tools.name: add_project_pin
tools.description: Add an attributable note or safe http(s) link to the shared project workspace.

tools.name: remove_project_pin
tools.description: Remove one shared workspace pin. The operation is idempotent.

tools.name: prepare_version_export
tools.description: Create a five-minute download URL for an exact saved version. Source is delivered by the download route, never embedded in MCP model output.

tools.name: get_version_share_link
tools.description: Read the durable sharing state and current URL for one exact saved version. Disabled shares return no URL.

tools.name: create_version_share_link
tools.description: Create or recover a durable public or code-protected link for one exact saved version. Reusing the idempotency key returns the original result.

tools.name: revoke_version_share_link
tools.description: Disable every existing public or code-protected URL for one exact saved version. Re-publishing a protected link rotates its code.

tools.name: list_artifacts
tools.description: List durable project artifacts and each latest immutable version without returning stored bytes.

tools.name: get_artifact
tools.description: Read one artifact's immutable version history, provenance, attribution, digests, and review states without returning stored bytes.

tools.name: prepare_artifact_upload
tools.description: Create a five-minute PUT URL for exact bytes. External-agent output always enters pending review and never replaces the current artifact version before approval.

tools.name: prepare_artifact_download
tools.description: Create a five-minute download URL for one immutable artifact version. Stored bytes never enter MCP model output.

tools.name: list_artifact_approval_requests
tools.description: List exact artifact versions awaiting or carrying a human review decision. Requires separately delegated artifact review authority.

tools.name: approve_artifact_version
tools.description: Approve one pending immutable artifact version and make it current. Repeating the same decision is idempotent.

tools.name: reject_artifact_version
tools.description: Reject one pending immutable artifact version with useful feedback. Repeating the same decision is idempotent.

tools.name: get_task_quality_gate
tools.description: Return the current task-bound Quality Gate policy, freshness, deterministic check receipt, and attached findings. A pass never replaces required human visual or approval review.

tools.name: run_task_quality_gate
tools.description: Start checks against exact task/artifact/environment fingerprints, or submit every configured check with same-project evidence and explicit findings. Missing routes, stale proof, failed checks, and open findings cannot become a false pass.

tools.name: get_work_handoff
tools.description: Return the current immutable context-handoff receipt, exact task lineage, and honestly labeled worker-reported or 2ools-forecast context signal.

tools.name: prepare_work_handoff
tools.description: Checkpoint one owned session into an immutable, exactly-once successor envelope. Estimated signals are labeled as estimates; questions and possibly committed effects stay paused for a person.

tools.name: list_work_assignments
tools.description: List durable project work contracts, bounded attempts, leases, budgets, and result references.

tools.name: create_work_assignment
tools.description: Create a durable assignment with acceptance criteria and hard step, time, and spend ceilings.

tools.name: claim_work_assignment
tools.description: Atomically claim one open assignment and receive a five-minute renewable lease plus an immutable budget snapshot.

tools.name: heartbeat_work_session
tools.description: Renew the authenticated worker's active lease without widening its immutable step, time, or spend ceilings.

tools.name: checkpoint_work_session
tools.description: End the current lease with a compact continuation checkpoint, or place work in an explicit waiting or blocked state. Ambiguous external effects always wait for reconciliation and are never auto-retried.

tools.name: submit_work_session
tools.description: End the authenticated worker's lease and submit typed result references for a separate review decision.

tools.name: decide_work_assignment
tools.description: Complete submitted work or reopen it with useful feedback. Requires separately delegated work-review authority.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_public_preview, list_connected_engines, get_project_engine_workspace, get_build, get_project_context, activate_project, update_living_plan, get_project_work_dispatch, list_project_feedback, get_version_share_link, get_artifact, list_artifact_approval_requests, get_task_quality_gate · Private data: create_public_preview, list_build_systems, list_connected_engines, get_project_engine_workspace, attach_project_engine_workspace, register_existing_project, get_account_profile, update_account_profile, invite_project_member, get_project_context, refresh_project_cockpit, activate_project, get_project_discipline, list_project_engineering_decisions, get_agent, get_project_work_dispatch · Public sink: approve_version, update_account_profile, invite_project_member, review_project_mission, render_project_preview, get_version_share_link, create_version_share_link, revoke_version_share_link, prepare_artifact_upload, run_task_quality_gate, submit_work_session · Destructive: remove_project_member, get_project_discipline, manage_project_discipline, list_project_agents, get_agent, run_project_agent, cancel_agent_run, add_project_feedback, remove_project_pin, run_task_quality_gate.
